name: Integrated Biosciences PhD
detailsNote: Official available requirements. Current Fall 2027 application deadline established. Funding amounts have no stated academic year unless noted; confirm offer. Admission model omitted unless directly established.

english.toefl: 79 with W21/R19 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 total/W/R on or after
english.note: IELTS reading/writing 6.5; Fall 2027 DET total/reading/writing 120. Scores within two years of start. Twin Cities does not accept TOEFL MyBest; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted. Education exemption: secondary school in US/listed country, or 16 semester/24 quarter non-ESL postsecondary credits completed within past two years while living in US/listed country. Program may require higher scores.

applicationFee.note: US citizen/PR $75, international $95; nonrefundable. Central office does not waive fees. GSDO conditional route is limited to US citizens/permanent residents seeking their first graduate degree with qualifying participation; request before submission/payment. No IBS-specific international waiver established.

documents: Diversity of Views and Experiences statement
requirements.note: Systemwide research PhD with campus choice specified in application and personal statement. GRE optional; if sent, suggested 60th percentile and official scores within five years. Optional writing sample/research description considered. Homepage supplies dated Fall 2027 deadlines; spring availability depends on funding and must be confirmed with the IBS office.

funding.note: Research/teaching assistantships available; holders receive health benefits and tuition waivers. No universal offer or stipend amount established.
